historical_references.reference: The name 'Inhal' is also associated with a significant event in the history of the Mughal Empire in India, specifically under the rule of Emperor Akbar. The village of Inhal, near the city of Agra, was the site of the Battle of Teen Mansoon, in which Akbar's forces defeated the combined armies of his rebellious sons and the Rajputs. The name 'Inhal' is said to have derived from the Sanskrit word 'inhala', meaning 'to crush', reflecting the decisive victory that took place there.
